name: Kingdom of Norway

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024: land area 364,270 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2). Low/high allow for the Natural Earth polygon vs official figure and inland water (surface area is a few % larger).

population.note: asOf 2025: World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 5,610,870. Everything inside ne:NOR; Svalbard and Jan Mayen are separate Natural Earth units.

activePersonnel.note: IISS as quoted: 25,400 active incl. conscripts. CIA Factbook 2025 ~27,000 (high).

supportPersonnel.note: Active 25,400 minus infantry P roles (4,500). Covers navy and air force personnel, armour/artillery/air-defence crews, logistics, staff, training and other support.

mobilizationRatio.note: Analogy to Cold War Norway (~320,000 wartime strength from ~4 million, ~8%) scaled down for today's smaller structure.

armor.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Leopard 2A4 now, 2A8 arriving.

ships.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Aegis frigates, stealth corvettes.

fortification.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Hardened mountain facilities (Olavsvern, Bardufoss).

logistics.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Arctic logistics, prepositioned US Marine stocks.

cyber.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: National Cyber Security Centre.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 427,471,601,113 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD x 0.8005) / population 5,610,870 = 76,186. Range +/-10%.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 534,005,747,799 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 427,471,601,113 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS: 3.28% of GDP in 2025 (mid), 2.23% in 2024, 1.68% in 2021. Low is the lowest of those years; high allows ~5% for NATO-definition spending above SIPRI.

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction 34.5% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-1.5 pp for year-to-year variation.

foodSurplus.note: Educated guess. Large fish exporter, otherwise imports ~50% of food.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 2,828,205 (SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN) x share of males aged 15-19 6.209% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 35,122. Males only (conscript-pool convention); about double if women are counted. Range +/-10%.

air_defense.note: Educated guess. Kongsberg NASAMS fire units (mostly exported). (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_equipment_of_the_Norwegian_Army)

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 3,885 route-km (IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). Low allows for closures since.

merchantTonnage.note: UNCTAD 2025 as quoted: 21,354 thousand DWT under the Norwegian flag (NOR + NIS); Norwegian owners control much more under foreign flags (educated high).

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. By analogy to NATO mechanized brigade sustainment (truck-based, depots every ~150-200 km).

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Horses, mules and donkeys, not from FAO data. Militarily irrelevant in 2026.

nuclearWarheads.note: Non-nuclear-weapon state (NPT); FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 lists only nine nuclear-armed states. FAS lists the five US B61 host states (Belgium, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Turkey); this state is not one of them.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.3: mountains and fjords, Arctic climate, long thin geography, strong population support.

notes: Modern snapshot, asOf 2025 World Bank data with an Oct 2026 order of battle. Population convention: mainland Norway inside ne:NOR. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Force counts from the Wikipedia Norwegian Army equipment list, active Norwegian military aircraft list and navy article; drones = Group 2+ only. NASAMS and drone counts are educated guesses (grade D). Infantry P-role splits are educated guesses (grade D). Home Guard counted as reserves.
